* [ADR-001 — ADR-001: One agy process per turn, two legs chosen by mode, never under --sandbox](ADR-001-one-agy-process-per-turn.md) - **Accepted** — The plugin spawns one print-mode agy process per turn with no broker, picks the review or task leg by --mode, never runs a task leg under --sandbox, adopts ADR-014's runtime rule and ships a thin forwarding subagent.
* [ADR-002 — ADR-002: agy runs on an allowlisted environment; disk reads by the unsandboxed engine are accepted residual risk](ADR-002-engine-environment-allowlist.md) - **Accepted** — The runtime starts agy with an allowlisted environment and stores no prompt text.
